manually_added_note: Five CNCF queries (q201-q205) added to test_queries.json on 2026-04-24 PM to address cncf under-representation observed in the first-pass sampling (initial pure-cncf queries=1). See paper/code_fixes_2026-04-24.md "CNCF augmentation + Minimal Mode" section for full rationale.
strategy: Scarcity-first stratified sampling with deterministic seed=42. Multi-cloud queries counted toward every provider they mention. Sampling order: kubernetes -> cncf -> gcp -> azure -> aws, excluding already-picked ids. Deficit from low-resource strata redistributed to aws:azure:gcp proportional to original targets (13:13:10) via largest-remainder method.
